model_annotation: This image displays a nested donut chart representing two related data categorizations, with "Ambiguity Std" displayed on the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" on the inner ring. The chart consists of a total of seven slices, comprising four in the outer ring and three in the inner ring. Two corresponding legends are provided on the right side of the image to identify the categories by color. The outer ring features a dark blue slice for "Std: 0.0" (49.0%), a medium blue slice for "Std: 0.47" (39.0%), a bright cyan slice for "Std: 0.94" (7.0%), and a lighter blue slice for "Std: 0.82" (5.0%). The inner ring includes a vibrant blue slice representing "Max: 1" (47.7%), a lighter blue slice for "Max: 2" (38.0%), and a very pale powder blue slice for "Max: 3" (14.2%). Bolded percentage labels are located directly inside each slice, utilizing either black or white text to contrast with the background color. No slices are exploded or structurally offset for emphasis, and while the largest segments occupy the left and bottom portions of the chart, the slices are not arranged in strict ascending or descending order of size.
